propositions: Manifest byte-equality tests fail intermittently under pytest-xdist when concurrent workers modify the git checkout, causing git status --porcelain to return different -dirty states between separate build_manifest calls.
The gate_code_version() function shells git status on every invocation, embedding a racy live git state in each manifest stamp rather than a pinned provenance.
Two manifest byte-equality tests compare outputs built by separate calls without monkeypatching gate_code_version, leaving them vulnerable to concurrent git state changes.

Monkeypatching rebar.signing.gate_code_version to a constant in byte-equality tests pins provenance and eliminates the flake, following the existing pattern in test_no_pins_preserves_legacy_manifest_bytes.

After pinning gate_code_version in test_manifest_file_scope_contract_preserves_legacy_bytes and test_manifest_is_deterministic_and_path_independent, all manifest byte-equality tests in the repo are deterministic under xdist.
